gaps.sentence: Put ___ your coat — it's freezing outside.
gaps.explanation: put on = dress in; put off = postpone.

gaps.sentence: You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.

gaps.sentence: Do you get ___ well with your new colleagues?
gaps.explanation: get on (with) = have a good relationship; also get along with (AmE).

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
Her honesty more than makes ___ for her lack of experience.
gaps.explanation: 'Make up for' = compensate for a shortcoming.

gaps.sentence: During the tour she pointed ___ the oldest house in town.
gaps.explanation: point out = mention/draw attention to a fact.

gaps.sentence: Could you look ___ my suitcase while I buy the tickets?
gaps.explanation: look after = take care of; look for = search; look up = check in a reference.

gaps.sentence: We've ___ out of milk — could you get some more?
